description: This file defines a mock class 'TestModuleMock' for unit testing, which inherits from 'firebolt::rialto::TestModule'. It uses Google Mock to mock methods related to IPC testing, including request and response handling for various test scenarios. The class provides utility methods to generate response objects and simulate success or failure conditions.

classes.name: TestModuleMock
classes.description: A mock class for 'firebolt::rialto::TestModule' used in IPC testing, providing mocked methods for request and response handling, as well as utility functions for generating responses and simulating success or failure.

methods.name: TestRequestSingleVar
methods.description: Mock method for handling a single variable test request.

methods.name: TestRequestMultiVar
methods.description: Mock method for handling a multi-variable test request.

methods.name: TestResponseSingleVar
methods.description: Mock method for handling a single variable response.

methods.name: TestResponseMultiVar
methods.description: Mock method for handling a multi-variable response.

methods.name: TestRequestSingleVarNoReply
methods.description: Mock method for handling a request that does not expect a reply.

methods.name: defaultReturn
methods.description: Simulates a successful RPC call by invoking 'done->Run()'.

methods.name: failureReturn
methods.description: Simulates a failed RPC call by setting the controller's failure state and invoking 'done->Run()'.

methods.name: getSingleVarResponse
methods.description: Creates and returns a 'TestSingleVar' response with the specified 'var1' value.

methods.name: getMultiVarResponse
methods.description: Creates and returns a 'TestMultiVar' response with specified 'var1', 'var2', 'var3', and 'var4' values.
